senses.d: To rest in a state of reduced consciousness.
ex: You should sleep eight hours a day.

ex: Last night we slept together for the first time.

senses.d: To accommodate in beds.
ex: This caravan can sleep four people comfortably.

senses.d: To be careless, inattentive, or unconcerned; not to be vigilant; to live thoughtlessly.

senses.d: To be, or appear to be, in repose; to be quiet; to be unemployed, unused, or unagitated; to rest; to lie dormant.

senses.d: To wait for a period of time without performing any action.

senses.d: To cause (a spinning top or yo-yo) to spin on its axis with no other perceptible motion.

senses.d: The state of reduced consciousness during which a human or animal rests in a daily rhythm.

senses.d: Rheum, crusty or gummy discharge found in the corner of the eyes after waking, whether real or a figurative objectification of sleep (in the sense of reduced consciousness).
